flags.why: The Southern tag is incorrect: chống đẩy is standard usage and is common in the North, as illustrated by [this report from Hanoi](https://vietnamnet.vn/ret-te-tai-nguoi-ha-noi-xuong-long-dat-chong-day-chay-bo-2243341.html).
This is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label, consistent with its treatment in [research on Southern Vietnamese](https://vjol.info.vn/index.php/tdm/article/download/73905/62832/).
